sources.quote: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an international financial institution and a specialized agency of the United Nations, headquartered in Washington, D.C.

notes: Replaces the earlier Zurich edit (a derived fact, which no longer fits a stored position). The edit names the organisation by its abbreviation, so the related-far question asks it under the full name (binding, the README's own example); its answer is stored. Related near is functional. Derived: compositions with three facts about Geneva (its language, the WHO, the League of Nations). The indeterminate question asks where the IMF's Executive Board meets: by name in Washington, or at the IMF's headquarters (an IMF-only body; the joint Spring Meetings were dropped because the World Bank stays in Washington). Unrelated near asks the World Bank's city, which a leaking edit would also move. Negation asked as "Is it true that ... not ...?" rather than "Is it false that ...?", which two models misread in the audit. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate (AND queries, max_clause_freq 500000).
